text: やまの　くうき　すい　すぎて　はらが　ふくれた！

structure.jp: やまの　くうき　すい　すぎて
structure.en: I breathed in too much mountain air, so

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb means doing it too much. すい　すぎて = 'breathing in too much'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next one, here giving the reason for it. すい　すぎて = 'I breathed in too much, and so'.
